scope: Original implementation turn including its final assistant response; all follow-up publication work excluded. No subagents used.
tier_verification: Service tier is not recorded in session turn_context; Standard assumed from operator rate card.
long_context_pricing: Official model page: above 272K input, 2x input/cache and 1.5x output; no recorded request crosses threshold.
source: Operator-supplied rate-card image, corroborated with https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-sol on 2026-10-21
exclusions: Account subscription fees, taxes, credits and any unexposed tool-side model/billing usage
formula: (input - cached_input)*2/1e6 + cached_input*0.10/1e6 + cache_write*2.50/1e6 + output*10/1e6; reasoning output already included in output.
